Chapter 768: Chapter 1 Inventory Gains (Subscribe Requested)

In the depths of the cosmic starry skies.

This is a desolate star domain, where, for hundreds of thousands of light-years around, not a single planet is seen.

Just then, a slight spatial fluctuation sent out ripples, and Lin Yuan’s figure appeared out of nowhere.

“Where is this?”

“The territory of the Star Alliance?”

Lin Yuan immediately used the position of his true body as a “coordinate” to determine his current location.

...

“I didn’t expect that the ‘White Paper’ senior would send me here,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. Before leaving this universe, the half-meter-tall elder had casually tossed Lin Yuan out.

And according to Lin Yuan, the farther away the better, given that there were dozens of ultimate beings surrounding ‘White Paper’ at the time.

Being thrown too close, causing ultimate beings who were adept at the Space Great Tao to detect abnormalities, would have been troublesome.

“I wonder if I’ll have the chance to meet ‘White Paper’ senior again,” Lin Yuan mused from within the depths of multiple spatial layers, looking towards a far distant point where a massive spatial crack was slowly healing.

The trip to the low-dimensional space had made a deep impression on Lin Yuan and given him more speculation about the Door to the Myriad Realms.

So-called low-dimensional spaces are merely the product created by those near-perfect temporal beings to explore other dimensions.

That is to say, even beings nearing perfect temporal life cannot break dimensional limitations and wander through different dimensions.

But the Door to the Myriad Realms? It easily accomplishes this feat.

“Could it be that the Door to the Myriad Realms is a treasure at the level of perfect temporal life?” Lin Yuan hypothesized in his mind. From the half-meter-tall elder, he had learned of the terrifying nature of perfect temporal life, almost omnipotent, capable of easily overturning timelines if they wished.

“Forget it.”

“Thinking about this now is too premature.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts.

He wasn’t even a Supreme Being now; considering perfect temporal life was meaningless.

Anyway, the Door to the Myriad Realms already recognized him as its master; once his power reached that level, everything would become clear.

“I should head back as soon as possible.”

After surveying his surroundings and confirming there were no powerful beings from the Star Alliance nearby, Lin Yuan immediately planned to return to the territory of human civilization.

The Star Alliance’s territory is vast, but it’s a typical case of “wide land with few people.”

After all, the Star Alliance is primarily made up of many special life forms.

And special life forms… do not have the reproductive capabilities like human civilizations,

Even the most common special life form probably takes decades or even hundreds of years for a single reproductive cycle.

Of course, the Insect Race has the strongest reproductive ability.

However, the Insect Race creating Insect Race warriors doesn’t entirely count as reproduction, as Insect Race warriors are completely controlled by the queen with no independent will, so they don’t qualify as life.

As for reproduction among the formal members of the Insect Race, it takes even longer than most special life forms.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan took a step, disappeared, and reappeared a million light-years away.

Having grasped the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, the speed at which Lin Yuan traveled had increased by who knows how much. A single step covering a million light-years was already the result of him actively restraining himself, to prevent causing too large of a spatial fluctuation that might attract the attention of powerful special life forms within the territory.

If Lin Yuan were to go all out, he could easily take a step spanning ten million light-years, or even tens of millions of light-years. In short, since grasping the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, distance had lost much of its meaning to Lin Yuan.

If Lin Yuan could elevate the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule to the Second Realm, the Third Realm, the distance he could cross in one step would only increase.

“What if I combined it with the ‘Nine Steps of Space-Time’?” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, deciding to wait for an opportunity to test his ultimate speed.

…

The Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, a smile appearing on his face.

The trip into the two-dimensional world, though fraught with great danger that risked erasing his Taiyang Divine Spirit completely, thus affecting the foundation of his Martial Tao,

was, at the same time, hugely rewarding as long as he could get out smoothly.

The first gain was everything from the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, their physical bodies, souls, and many other mysteries, as well as their understanding and comprehension of the rules, all of which fell into Lin Yuan’s hands.

Although according to the half-meter-tall elder’s intention, except for the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule Comprehension, other aspects were all unrefined and unpurified,

therefore Lin Yuan had to be a bit more careful when studying them, but it was still far beyond his expectations and countless times easier than starting from scratch.

Next came the ‘exotic objects.’

Being able to wander every corner of the two-dimensional world for ten thousand years, Lin Yuan naturally acquired quite a few exotic objects.

These objects were not very useful in the two-dimensional world, at least not to Lin Yuan, who was invincible in that world at the time; they made no difference to him.

But as soon as he brought them out, they would be considered Twelve-Star Strange Treasures.

“If I had known that only one victor could exist, I could have extorted those peak clans again,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

During the second opening of the Heaven’s Gate, when Lin Yuan pushed it open, the other powerhouses of the Myriad Clans instinctively believed that they could do the same, so they didn’t plan to let Lin Yuan bring out the exotic objects.

“Hmm?”

“Actually, there was no need for the Taiyang Divine Spirit to rush…”

A thought occurred to Lin Yuan.

He suddenly remembered he had another identity, that of the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm, founded by Xuanhuang, is rooted in this universe. As its master, Lin Yuan could directly enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm with the assistance of the Xuanhuang Seal, as long as he was within this universe.

Then, through the ‘transfer’ of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he could return to the Milky Way Star Region.

…

Within the territory of the Star Alliance.

The traveling Lin Yuan stopped, then activated the Xuanhuang Seal deep within his soul, and his figure quickly vanished, getting pulled into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.
